desc.en: Discover the true meaning of fear in Alien: Isolation, a survival horror set in an atmosphere of constant dread and mortal danger...   Created using the CATHODE™ engine.
desc.fr: Découvrez le vrai sens de la peur dans Alien: Isolation, un survival horror se déroulant dans une atmosphère d'épouvante et de danger constants.   Créé avec le moteur CATHODE™.
desc.zh-CN: 在《Alien: Isolation》这款以持续恐惧和致命危险气氛为背景的生存恐怖游戏中，发掘恐惧的真正意义。   使用 CATHODE™ 引擎打造。
desc.ja: 絶え間ない不安と死の危険の気配が迫る『Alien: Isolation』で真の恐怖を味わおう。   CATHODE™エンジンを使用して制作。
desc.es: Descubre el verdadero significado del terror en Alien: Isolation, un juego de horror y supervivencia que transcurre en un ambiente de constante tensión y peligro.   Creado con el motor de juego CATHODE™.

desc.en: Konami's Castlevania Anniversary Collection traces the origins of the historic vampire franchise. Included is a unique eBook with details provided by developers, artists and others inspired by the Castlevania legacy which sheds a fresh light into the world of Castlevania.
desc.fr: La collection Konami Castlevania Collection retrace les origines de la franchise du célèbre vampire.
desc.zh-CN: Konami's Castlevania Anniversary Collection traces the origins of the historic vampire franchise. Included is a unique eBook with details provided by developers, artists and others inspired by the Castlevania legacy which sheds a fresh light into the world of Castlevania.
desc.ja: コナミグループ創業50周年を記念し、珠玉の名作を集めた「アニバーサリーコレクション」が登場！　本作ではムチを武器に魔王ドラキュラに挑むホラーアクション「悪魔城ドラキュラ」シリーズの初期８タイトルに加え、秘蔵の開発資料を見られる大ボリュームの「ボーナスブック」を収録。
desc.es: Konami's Castlevania Anniversary Collection traces the origins of the historic vampire franchise. Included is a unique eBook with details provided by developers, artists and others inspired by the Castlevania legacy which sheds a fresh light into the world of Castlevania.

desc.en: Eternal Threads is a single-player, first-person story-driven puzzle game of time manipulation, choice and consequence.
desc.fr: Eternal Threads est un jeu de réflexion narratif, solo, en vue subjective, de manipulation temporelle, de choix et de conséquences.
desc.zh-CN: 《无穷时线》是一款关于时间操纵、选择和结果的第一人称剧情驱动型单机解谜游戏。
desc.ja: 『Eternal Threads』は、時間を操作し、選択することで、結末を変えていく、シングルプレイでストーリー主体のパズルゲームです。
desc.es: Eternal Threads es un juego de puzles en primera persona narrativo de un jugador que trata de manipulación temporal, decisiones y consecuencias.

desc.en: Ghostrunner 2 is a hardcore FPP slasher set in a post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk world. Featuring everything fans loved about Ghostrunner plus incredible boss fights, new interactive story, thrilling motorbike levels, improved skills, and more cyber ninja action.
desc.fr: Ghostrunner 2 est un slasher FPP intense se déroulant dans un monde cyberpunk post-apocalyptique. Il comprend tout ce que les fans ont adoré dans Ghostrunner, avec en plus des combats de boss, une nouvelle histoire interactive, des niveaux en moto palpitants, des compétences améliorées et plus d'act
desc.zh-CN: 《幽灵行者 2》是第一人称视角硬核砍杀游戏的续作，故事背景设定在后世界末日的赛博朋克世界。游戏延续了《幽灵行者》粉丝喜爱的所有内容，包括精彩绝伦的 BOSS 战、全新的可互动式剧情主线、刺激的摩托车关卡、重新优化的技能以及更多生化忍者的打斗场面。
desc.ja: 『ゴーストランナー 2』は、サイバーパンクの街を駆け抜けるハードコアFPPアクションゲーム！『ゴーストランナー』で好評だった要素に加え、熾烈なボス戦、没入感あふれる新たなストーリー、迫力満点のバイクステージ、改良されたスキル、サイバー忍者アクションが集結！
desc.es: Ghostrunner 2 es acción hardcore en primera persona con katanas en un mundo ciberpunk postapocalíptico. Con lo que gustó de Ghostrunner e increíbles batallas contra jefes, más habilidades, una historia interactiva, niveles en moto y más acción ciberninja.

desc.en:
Recruit units, place them strategically, and find the synergies in this Roguelike AutoBattler!
Knightica lets you guide a warband through challenges to free the Kingdoms.
Discover combinations, weave powerful enchants, face dangerous monsters, and lead your army to victory!
desc.fr:
Recrutez des unités puissantes, placez-les stratégiquement et trouvez les meilleures synergies dans cet Autobattler Roguelike !
Knightica vous permet de guider une bande à travers de nombreux défis pour libérer les royaumes.
Découvrez des combinaisons optimales, tissez de puissants enchantements, af
desc.zh-CN:
在这款类Rogue自走棋游戏中，征招强大单位，悉心排兵布阵，调整策略，充分发掘军队的协同效果！
 在《Knightica》中，你将指挥一整支战团，跨越重重挑战，最后解放王国。
 优化组合方案，巧用附魔法术，迎战危险怪物，最终带领你的军队走向胜利！
desc.ja:
強力なユニットを戦略的に配置して、シナジーを得るローグライク・オートバトラー。
目的は戦隊を率いて数々の敵に挑み、王国を解放すること。
部隊の最適な組み合わせを見つけ、強力な魔法を編み出し、危険なモンスターと対決して、自軍を勝利に導こう！
desc.es:
Recluta unidades, sitúalas estratégicamente y descubre sinergias increíbles en este roguelike con luchas automáticas.
En Knightica, liderarás un ejército y superarás retos para liberar los Reinos.
Encuentra combinaciones óptimas, crea encantamientos, enfréntate a monstruos ¡y álzate con la victoria!

desc.en: Explore Olathe and unmask its twisted secrets with LISA: The Definitive Edition, including the original narrative-driven RPG LISA: The Painful and its sequel LISA: The Joyful.
desc.fr: Explorez Olathe et découvrez ses terribles secrets avec LISA: Definitive Edition, qui contient le jeu de rôle narratif d'origine LISA: The Painful et sa suite, LISA: The Joyful.
desc.zh-CN: 入手《LISA: Definitive Edition》，探索 Olathe，揭开背后隐藏的扭曲秘密。Definitive Edition 包括叙事驱动角色扮演原作《LISA: The Painful》及续作《LISA: The Joyful》。
desc.ja: オレイサを探索し、オリジナルのストーリー重視のRPG『LISA: The Painful』とその続編『LISA: The Joyful』を収録した『LISA: Definitive Edition』で、倒錯した謎を明かそう。
desc.es: Explora Olathe y descubre sus retorcidos secretos con LISA: Definitive Edition, que incluye el RPG narrativo original LISA: The Painful y su secuela, LISA: The Joyful.

name: Lost Castle: The Old Ones Awaken

desc.en: The Old Ones Awaken adds new levels to explore, new enemies to defeat, and new bosses to face along with a host exciting new weapons and equipment to wield and wear.
desc.fr: Les Chasseurs de trésor ont creusé trop profondément sous Castle Harwood, et les voilà dans des lieux qui n’auraient jamais dû sortir de l’oubli.
desc.zh-CN: “遗迹的守护者” DLC中包含了两张全新的地图等你来挑战！
desc.ja: Old Ones Awakenには、新たなレベルが含まれています！
desc.es: ¡The Old Ones Awaken incluye nuevos niveles que explorar!

desc.en: The skies are aflame and the seas will overflow with wreckage in Vlambeer’s stylish arcade shooter LUFTRAUSERS! Take to the skies in customized fighter planes to battle battleships, submarines, and rival aces for glory, honor, and high scores.
desc.fr: The skies are aflame and the seas will overflow with wreckage in Vlambeer’s stylish arcade shooter LUFTRAUSERS! Take to the skies in customized fighter planes to battle battleships, submarines, and rival aces for glory, honor, and high scores.
desc.zh-CN: The skies are aflame and the seas will overflow with wreckage in Vlambeer’s stylish arcade shooter LUFTRAUSERS! Take to the skies in customized fighter planes to battle battleships, submarines, and rival aces for glory, honor, and high scores.
desc.ja: The skies are aflame and the seas will overflow with wreckage in Vlambeer’s stylish arcade shooter LUFTRAUSERS! Take to the skies in customized fighter planes to battle battleships, submarines, and rival aces for glory, honor, and high scores.
desc.es: The skies are aflame and the seas will overflow with wreckage in Vlambeer’s stylish arcade shooter LUFTRAUSERS! Take to the skies in customized fighter planes to battle battleships, submarines, and rival aces for glory, honor, and high scores.

desc.en: Mark of the Deep is an epic pirate-themed adventure with a strong narrative and a thrilling mix of Metroidvania and Souls-Like elements. Embark on this journey, explore the mysteries of a cursed island and find your missing pirate crew!
desc.fr: Mark of the Deep est une aventure épique sur le thème des pirates, dotée d'une narration captivante et d'un mélange palpitant de Metroidvania et de souls-like. Lancez-vous dans ce périple, explorez les mystères d'une île maudite et retrouvez votre équipage de pirates disparu !
desc.zh-CN: 深渊之印是一款史诗般的海盗冒险游戏，拥有强烈的叙事性，并融合了广受好评的银河恶魔城游戏与魂系游戏的惊险元素。以海盗刘琦的身份踏上旅程，探索受诅咒岛屿的奥秘，寻找失踪的海盗船员！
desc.ja: 『Mark of the Deep』は、緻密なストーリー展開と、高く評価されているメトロイドヴァニアやソウルライクゲームの要素を組み合わせた壮大な海賊アドベンチャーです。プレイヤーは海賊ルーキーとして、呪われた島の謎を解き明かし、行方不明の仲間たちを探し出す旅に出ることになります！
desc.es: Mark of the Deep es una épica aventura pirata con fuerte narrativa y una emocionante mezcla de elementos de juegos Metroidvania y Souls-Like. ¡Embárcate en este viaje en la piel del pirata Rookie, explora los misterios de una isla maldita y encuentra a tus compañeros perdidos!

desc.en: Join the latest trend in simulation games, bring out your creativity and make awesome-looking models with the base game and all available DLCs. Assemble, customize and display your creations, whether you’re a veteran or a novice. Get building, and get creative!
desc.fr: Join the latest trend in simulation games, bring out your creativity and make awesome-looking models with the base game and all available DLCs. Assemble, customize and display your creations, whether you’re a veteran or a novice. Get building, and get creative!
desc.zh-CN: Join the latest trend in simulation games, bring out your creativity and make awesome-looking models with the base game and all available DLCs. Assemble, customize and display your creations, whether you’re a veteran or a novice. Get building, and get creative!
desc.ja: Join the latest trend in simulation games, bring out your creativity and make awesome-looking models with the base game and all available DLCs. Assemble, customize and display your creations, whether you’re a veteran or a novice. Get building, and get creative!
desc.es: Join the latest trend in simulation games, bring out your creativity and make awesome-looking models with the base game and all available DLCs. Assemble, customize and display your creations, whether you’re a veteran or a novice. Get building, and get creative!

desc.en: Embark on a journey of forgiveness through impossible environments and illusionary puzzles. Experience this meditative and calming puzzle game by manipulating monuments and creating evolving paths to explore new, surreal, and mysterious worlds.
desc.fr: Embarquez pour une odyssée rédemptrice à travers des environnements invraisemblables et des casse-tête trompeurs. Dans ce jeu de réflexion méditatif et apaisant, manipulez des monuments et formez des chemins évolutifs pour explorer de nouveaux mondes surréalistes et mystérieux.
desc.zh-CN: 踏上宽恕之旅，穿越几乎不可能破解的环境和幻想谜题。操纵纪念碑、创建不断发展的道路，探索全新超现实且神秘的世界，体验这款冥想且平静的解谜游戏。
desc.ja: 奇想天外な環境を進み、目を惑わすパズルを解きながら、許しの旅へと出かけましょう。この瞑想的なパズルゲームでモニュメントを操作し、展開する道を作りながら、斬新かつシュールで神秘的な世界を探検しましょう。
desc.es: Embárcate en un viaje de perdón a través de entornos imposibles y rompecabezas ilusorios. Sumérgete en este juego de rompecabezas meditativo y relajante, donde manipulas monumentos y creas caminos en constante evolución para explorar mundos nuevos, surrealistas y misteriosos.

desc.en: Build gorgeous kingdoms on floating islands by strategically placing buildings in this cozy, medieval City-Puzzler. Discover secret combinations, take on monthly challenges and explore randomly generated maps in various single- and multiplayer game modes.
desc.fr: Bâtissez de magnifiques royaumes sur des îles flottantes en plaçant vos bâtiments avec stratégie dans ce puzzle de construction médiéval chaleureux. Découvrez des combinaisons secrètes, relevez des défis hebdomadaires et explorez des cartes générées aléatoirement dans différents modes solo et multij
desc.zh-CN: 在这款温馨惬意的中世纪城市建造解谜游戏中，通过合理布局建筑，在浮空岛屿上打造壮丽王国。发现隐藏组合，挑战每周任务，并在多种单人和多人游戏模式中探索随机生成的地图。
desc.ja: 心地よい中世の街づくりパズルで、建物を戦略的に配置しながら浮遊島に美しい王国を築きましょう。秘密の組み合わせを発見し、ウィークリーチャレンジに挑戦し、さまざまなソロおよびマルチプレイモードで自動生成マップを探索できます。
desc.es: Construye reinos espectaculares sobre islas flotantes colocando edificios estratégicamente en este acogedor rompecabezas de construcción medieval. Descubre combinaciones secretas, enfréntate a desafíos semanales y explora mapas generados de forma procedimental en distintos modos para un jugador y mu

desc.en: Them's Fightin' Herds
desc.fr: Them's Fightin' Herds
desc.zh-CN: Them's Fightin' Herds
desc.ja: Them's Fightin' Herds
desc.es: Them's Fightin' Herds

desc.en: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.
desc.fr: Bâtissez votre royaume dans ce roguelike effréné. Étendez votre empire et livrez des batailles homériques contre de puissants rivaux royaux. Cassez le jeu avec des milliers de decks démentiels pour régner sans partage.
desc.zh-CN: 一款快节奏的王国建造类Roguelike游戏，数百张独特卡牌，数千种疯狂构筑，突破游戏规则……与九王史诗对决、赢得战斗、扩展帝国，成就众王之王！
desc.ja: 高速ペースのローグライク王国建設ゲーム。帝国を成長させ、対立する強力な王たちと大規模な戦いを繰り広げろ。無数の常識外れの組み合わせでゲームをぶち壊し、王の中の王となれ。
desc.es: Levanta tu imperio en este trepidante constructor de reinos roguelike. Libra cruentas batallas contra tus homónimos rivales. Explota las mecánicas con cientos de construcciones increíbles para convertirte en el rey de reyes.

desc.en: An exploratory RPG where you freely roam the surface and dungeons, craft gear, customize your home, and travel at your own pace while uncovering hidden history amid the turmoil surrounding the Empire's historical records.
desc.fr: An exploratory RPG where you freely roam the surface and dungeons, craft gear, customize your home, and travel at your own pace while uncovering hidden history amid the turmoil surrounding the Empire's historical records.
desc.zh-CN: An exploratory RPG where you freely roam the surface and dungeons, craft gear, customize your home, and travel at your own pace while uncovering hidden history amid the turmoil surrounding the Empire's historical records.
desc.ja: 地上とダンジョンを自由に探索しつつ、入手した素材で装備や道具を製造したり、自分の家をカスタマイズしたり、旅人となり自由に旅をしつつ、帝国が管理する歴史書を巡って巻き起こる騒動を追いかけ、隠された歴史を紐解いていく探索系ハクスラRPG。
desc.es: An exploratory RPG where you freely roam the surface and dungeons, craft gear, customize your home, and travel at your own pace while uncovering hidden history amid the turmoil surrounding the Empire's historical records.

desc.en: Xianxia auto-battler: 42 cultivators, 7 elements, 14 bonds. Eight teams, 100 Embers each — lose them all and you are out. No fixed finish line: fight until you ascend or fall. Your rivals are real lineups left by other players — AI stand-ins when the player pool is thin.
desc.fr: Xianxia auto-battler: 42 cultivators, 7 elements, 14 bonds. Eight teams, 100 Embers each — lose them all and you are out. No fixed finish line: fight until you ascend or fall. Your rivals are real lineups left by other players — AI stand-ins when the player pool is thin.
desc.zh-CN: 修仙自走棋锦标赛：42 位仙家弟子、7 大元素、14 种羁绊、224种独特功法，自由搭配队伍、洗练功法，无数种可能。8 队各持 100 火种，输光即出局——没有固定终点，一直打到登顶或陨落。你的对手是历代玩家留下的真实阵容，人手不足时由 AI 补位。
desc.ja: Xianxia auto-battler: 42 cultivators, 7 elements, 14 bonds. Eight teams, 100 Embers each — lose them all and you are out. No fixed finish line: fight until you ascend or fall. Your rivals are real lineups left by other players — AI stand-ins when the player pool is thin.
desc.es: Xianxia auto-battler: 42 cultivators, 7 elements, 14 bonds. Eight teams, 100 Embers each — lose them all and you are out. No fixed finish line: fight until you ascend or fall. Your rivals are real lineups left by other players — AI stand-ins when the player pool is thin.

desc.en: Bodycam is the first tactical multiplayer FPS with a true body-camera view in Unreal Engine 5. Close-quarters combats feel raw and loud. Every angle, callout, and bullet matters. Play Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Wingman on photoreal maps where teamplay, tactics, and clutch skill are key.
desc.fr: Bodycam est le premier FPS multijoueur tactique avec une véritable vue de caméra corporelle dans Unreal Engine 5. Les combats rapprochés semblent bruts et bruyants. Chaque angle, légende et puce compte. Jouez à Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch et Wingman sur des cartes photoréalistes où le jeu d'équipe.
desc.zh-CN: Bodycam 是虚幻引擎 5 中第一款具有真实随身摄像机视图的战术多人 FPS。近距离战斗感觉原始而响亮。每个角度、标注和项目符号都很重要。在逼真的地图上玩死亡竞赛、团队死亡竞赛和僚机，其中团队合作、战术和关键技能是关键没有准星、弹药计数器或 HUD。团队协作与战术决策将决定胜负。每一次交火都要求你保持冷静、精准并迅速行动。沉浸在逼真的战场中，与队友配合完成任务。在瞬息万变的战局中，善用掩体、聆听声音并掌握每个关键时刻。
desc.ja: Bodycam は、Unreal Engine 5 での真のボディカメラ ビューを備えた初の戦術的マルチプレイヤー FPS です。接近戦は生々しくて騒々しいように感じられます。あらゆる角度、吹き出し、箇条書きが重要です。チームプレイ、戦術、クラッチ スキルが鍵となるフォトリアル マップで、デスマッチ、チーム デスマッチ、ウィングマンをプレイします HUDはありません。チームワークと戦術が勝敗を分けます。
desc.es: Bodycam es el primer FPS táctico multijugador con una vista real de la cámara corporal en Unreal Engine 5. Los combates cuerpo a cuerpo se sienten crudos y ruidosos. Cada ángulo, leyenda y viñeta importa. Juega Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch y Wingman en mapas fotorrealistas donde el juego en equipo.

desc.en: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.
desc.fr: La péninsule coréenne entre en guerre tandis que la Corée du Nord lance une invasion de grande envergure qui pourrait bien bouleverser le monde entier dans Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.
desc.zh-CN: 在《使命召唤®：现代战争® 4》中，朝鲜发动全面侵袭，半岛爆发战争，世界岌岌可危。
desc.ja: 「Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4」では、朝鮮半島で戦争が勃発。北朝鮮が大規模侵攻に踏み切り、世界情勢を揺るがす脅威が広がっていく。
desc.es: La guerra estalla en la península de Corea cuando Corea del Norte lanza una invasión a gran escala que amenaza con desestabilizar el mundo en Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

desc.en: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.
desc.fr: Casualties: Unknown est un simulateur de survie et de spéléologie. Vos capteurs vous envoient récupérer un chargement sur une planète inconnue où vous devrez réchapper aux environnements hostiles répartis sur 11 strates. Vous n'êtes que l'un des milliers de cobayes envoyés à une mort certaine.
desc.zh-CN: 《Casualties: Unknown》是一款残酷无情的洞穴探险生存游戏。身为俘虏的你被派到异星上找回丢失的货物，你需要探索这颗星球的全部11层洞穴，在各色恶劣环境中奋力求生。而你实际上只是成千上万被派来送死的实验体之一。
desc.ja: 『Casualties: Unknown』は過酷な洞窟環境を探索するサバイバルシミュレーション。囚われの身となったあなたは、未知の惑星で失われた貨物を回収する任務を課せられる。11層からなる階層を探索し、多種多様で過酷な環境で生き延びろ。あなたは死んだところで気にも留められない、何千もの被験者の1人に過ぎないのだが…
desc.es: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

desc.en: A 2D sci-fi action side-scroller where you fight to survive a facility overrun by biological nightmares. Blast through enemies with an arsenal of firearms, deeply customize your character's appearance, and avoid hazards, traps, and mutations.
desc.fr: A 2D sci-fi action side-scroller where you fight to survive a facility overrun by biological nightmares. Blast through enemies with an arsenal of firearms, deeply customize your character's appearance, and avoid hazards, traps, and mutations.
desc.zh-CN: 这是一款2D科幻横版动作游戏。在一座被生物梦魇占领的设施中，你必须为了生存而战。用丰富的枪械武器轰碎敌人，深度自定义你的角色外观，并努力避开各种危险、陷阱以及异种突变。
desc.ja: 生物的悪夢に支配された研究施設で生き残りを懸けて戦う、2D SF横スクロールアクションゲーム。多彩な銃器を駆使して敵を粉砕し、キャラクターの見た目を自由にカスタマイズしながら、数々の罠やハザード、そして肉体変異の脅威を回避せよ。
desc.es: Un juego de acción y ciencia ficción en 2D de desplazamiento lateral donde luchas por sobrevivir en una instalación plagada de pesadillas biológicas. Ábrete paso a tiros con un arsenal de armas de fuego, personaliza profundamente la apariencia de tu personaje y evita peligros, trampas y mutaciones.

name: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone

desc.en: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone is a robot voxel slice-em-up where any part of your body can be sliced off. With your mind downloaded into a robot gladiator, you must survive the sinister trials of the arena.
desc.fr: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone is a robot voxel slice-em-up where any part of your body can be sliced off. With your mind downloaded into a robot gladiator, you must survive the sinister trials of the arena.
desc.zh-CN: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone是一款第三人称刀剑格斗游戏，在游戏中你身体的任何部位都有可能被削的七零八落。由于意识被下载到了一个机器人角斗士身上，你必须在斗技场残酷的考验中顽强的活下来。
desc.ja: 『Clone Drone in the Danger Zone』は、体のあらゆる部分を切断できる、三人称視点のソードバトルアクションです。ロボットの剣闘士にインストールされた精神体であるあなたは、アリーナで待ち受ける凶悪な試練の数々を生き残らなければなりません。
desc.es: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone es un juego de luchas a espada en tercera persona, donde te pueden mutilar cualquier parte del cuerpo. Tu mente ha sido descargada en un robot gladiador y deberás sobrevivir a las siniestras pruebas de la arena de lucha.

desc.en: Unlock a world of thrill. Get unlimited access to a collection of EA’s top titles, trials of select new games, & member discounts and rewards*.
desc.fr: Découvrez un monde de sensations fortes. Profitez d'un accès illimité à une collection des meilleurs titres EA, des essais sur une sélection de nouveaux jeux, ainsi que des réductions et des récompenses pour les membres*.
desc.zh-CN: 解锁精彩世界。获取 EA 顶级游戏的无限畅玩权利、精选新游戏的试玩版及会员折扣与奖励*。
desc.ja: スリルあふれる世界をアンロック。EAのトップタイトルのコレクションや選り抜きの新作ゲームのトライアル、メンバー割引や報酬*を無制限に楽しもう。
desc.es: Desbloquea un mundo de emociones. Obtén acceso ilimitado a una colección de los mejores títulos de EA, pruebas de una selección de títulos nuevos, y descuentos y recompensas para miembros*.

desc.en: A brain-teasing puzzle game with a speedrun twist. Flip switches, rotate cells and guide your pawns to the exit. Then do it again, but faster.
desc.fr: Un jeu de réflexion qui vire au contre-la-montre. Actionnez des interrupteurs, faites pivoter des cellules et guidez vos pions jusqu'à la sortie. Puis recommencez, mais plus vite.
desc.zh-CN: 一款烧脑解谜游戏，解开之后就是速通挑战。 拨动开关、旋转格子，引导你的棋子抵达出口。 然后再来一次，这次更快。
desc.ja: スピードランの要素を秘めた、頭を使うパズルゲーム。 スイッチを切り替え、セルを回転させ、駒を出口へ導こう。 そしてもう一度、今度はもっと速く。
desc.es: Un juego de puzles de ingenio que se convierte en una carrera contrarreloj. Acciona interruptores, gira celdas y guía a tus fichas hasta la salida. Y luego, otra vez, pero más rápido.

desc.en: Build your goblin crew, upgrade your sword, and fight through 10 dungeons! Goblin & Glory is a pixel-art clicker game with auto-attacking helpers, relic choices, and 60-second boss battles. Earn prestige, unlock permanent abilities, and return stronger with every run.
desc.fr: Build your goblin crew, upgrade your sword, and fight through 10 dungeons! Goblin & Glory is a pixel-art clicker game with auto-attacking helpers, relic choices, and 60-second boss battles. Earn prestige, unlock permanent abilities, and return stronger with every run.
desc.zh-CN: Build your goblin crew, upgrade your sword, and fight through 10 dungeons! Goblin & Glory is a pixel-art clicker game with auto-attacking helpers, relic choices, and 60-second boss battles. Earn prestige, unlock permanent abilities, and return stronger with every run.
desc.ja: Build your goblin crew, upgrade your sword, and fight through 10 dungeons! Goblin & Glory is a pixel-art clicker game with auto-attacking helpers, relic choices, and 60-second boss battles. Earn prestige, unlock permanent abilities, and return stronger with every run.
desc.es: Build your goblin crew, upgrade your sword, and fight through 10 dungeons! Goblin & Glory is a pixel-art clicker game with auto-attacking helpers, relic choices, and 60-second boss battles. Earn prestige, unlock permanent abilities, and return stronger with every run.

desc.en: Run an e-sports organization on the road to Worlds. Sign and trade pro players, set the lineup and training, then draft and command your team in live 5v5 arena matches, or simulate them. Manage money, morale and chemistry season after season.
desc.fr: Run an e-sports organization on the road to Worlds. Sign and trade pro players, set the lineup and training, then draft and command your team in live 5v5 arena matches, or simulate them. Manage money, morale and chemistry season after season.
desc.zh-CN: Run an e-sports organization on the road to Worlds. Sign and trade pro players, set the lineup and training, then draft and command your team in live 5v5 arena matches, or simulate them. Manage money, morale and chemistry season after season.
desc.ja: Run an e-sports organization on the road to Worlds. Sign and trade pro players, set the lineup and training, then draft and command your team in live 5v5 arena matches, or simulate them. Manage money, morale and chemistry season after season.
desc.es: Run an e-sports organization on the road to Worlds. Sign and trade pro players, set the lineup and training, then draft and command your team in live 5v5 arena matches, or simulate them. Manage money, morale and chemistry season after season.

desc.en: Build a fearless feline crew, plunder treasure-filled shores, flip mysterious coins and upgrade your way to fortune! Conquer each beach, blast enemy ships and become the richest purrate captain the seven seas have ever seen.
desc.fr: Build a fearless feline crew, plunder treasure-filled shores, flip mysterious coins and upgrade your way to fortune! Conquer each beach, blast enemy ships and become the richest purrate captain the seven seas have ever seen.
desc.zh-CN: Build a fearless feline crew, plunder treasure-filled shores, flip mysterious coins and upgrade your way to fortune! Conquer each beach, blast enemy ships and become the richest purrate captain the seven seas have ever seen.
desc.ja: Build a fearless feline crew, plunder treasure-filled shores, flip mysterious coins and upgrade your way to fortune! Conquer each beach, blast enemy ships and become the richest purrate captain the seven seas have ever seen.
desc.es: Build a fearless feline crew, plunder treasure-filled shores, flip mysterious coins and upgrade your way to fortune! Conquer each beach, blast enemy ships and become the richest purrate captain the seven seas have ever seen.

desc.en: The idle MMO that lives above your Windows taskbar. Chop, smelt, slay and raid with your clan while you work. Every item you loot trades on the Steam Community Market · gear, keys, chests, even the pets. Free to play. No ads, no energy, no subscription.
desc.fr: MMO idle qui vit au-dessus de votre barre des tâches Windows. Coupez, fondez, combattez et raidez avec votre clan tout en travaillant. Tout votre butin s'échange sur le Marché communautaire Steam : équipements, clés, coffres, familiers. Free-to-play, sans pub ni abonnement.
desc.zh-CN: 活在你 Windows 任务栏上方的挂机 MMO。工作之余，和你的公会一起砍伐、熔炼、厮杀、突袭。你掠夺到的每件物品都能在 Steam 社区市场交易·装备、钥匙、宝箱，连宠物也不例外。免费游玩。没有广告、没有体力、没有订阅。
desc.ja: Windowsのタスクバーの上に住むアイドルMMO。仕事の合間に、クランと一緒に伐採し、精錬し、討伐し、レイドしよう。拾ったアイテムはすべてSteamコミュニティマーケットで取引可能·装備、鍵、チェスト、ペットまで。基本プレイ無料。広告なし、スタミナなし、サブスクなし。
desc.es: El MMO idle que vive sobre tu barra de tareas de Windows. Tala, funde, combate y haz raids con tu clan mientras trabajas. Todo lo que lootees se intercambia en el Mercado de la Comunidad de Steam · equipo, llaves, cofres, hasta las mascotas. Free-to-play. Sin anuncios, sin energía, sin suscripción.

desc.en: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.
desc.fr: Main Sequence est un jeu de simulation d'usine spatiale à la première personne où vous concevez des vaisseaux, des stations spatiales et des automatisations. Commencez avec un vaisseau, bâtissez un empire industriel interstellaire et marquez la galaxie.
desc.zh-CN: 《Main Sequence》是一款第一人称太空模拟工厂建造游戏。在游戏中，你将设计宇宙飞船、建造空间站，并实现全面自动化。从一艘飞船起步，逐步发展成横跨星际的工业帝国，在银河中留下属于你的印记。
desc.ja: 『Main Sequence』は一人称視点のスペースシミュ・工場作りゲーム。宇宙船を設計したり、宇宙ステーションを建築したり、あらゆるものを自動化できます。一隻の船から駆け出し、銀河を股にかける工業帝国を築き上げ、己の名前を銀河史に刻みましょう。
desc.es: Main Sequence es un juego de construcción de fábricas y simulador espacial en 1.ª persona en el que diseñas naves, construyes estaciones espaciales y lo automatizas todo. Empieza con una nave, conviértete en un imperio industrial interestelar y deja marca en la galaxia.

desc.en: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.
desc.fr: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.
desc.zh-CN: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.
desc.ja: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.
desc.es: Corta el pasto en primera persona arriba de un tractorcito destartalado, solo o en cooperativo online, hasta 6. Eres un viejo gruñón que fuma, toma cerveza barata y no le importa nada, pero deja franjas perfectas. Una vecina exigente, un campo de golf abandonado, una boda en una isla.

name: PAWHOLD: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game

desc.en: Somewhere out there, an AI keeps generating worlds and enemies to conquer mankind. Your cats are on the task. An idle pixel squad shooter that lives along the bottom of your screen while you work: four cat commandos fight, you click to help, bank the bounty and refit the crew.
desc.fr: Quelque part, une IA génère sans fin des mondes et des ennemis pour conquérir l'humanité. Vos chats sont sur le coup. Un shooter idle en pixel art niché en bas de l'écran pendant que vous bossez : quatre chats commandos se battent, vous aidez d'un clic, encaissez les primes et rééquipez l'équipe.
desc.zh-CN: 在遥远的某处，一个 AI 正不断生成世界和敌人，企图征服人类。而接下这项任务的，是你的猫咪们。这是一款趁你工作时待在屏幕底部的放置类像素小队射击游戏：四名猫咪突击队员负责战斗，你点点鼠标帮把手，存入赏金，再给小队改装整备。
desc.ja: どこか遠くで、AIが人類を征服するための世界と敵を生み出し続けている。迎え撃つのは、あなたのネコたち。仕事中、画面の下にずっといてくれる放置系ドット絵スクワッドシューター。4匹のネコ・コマンドーが戦い、あなたはクリックで援護。賞金を預けて、クルーを強化しよう。
desc.es: En algún lugar, una IA no para de generar mundos y enemigos para conquistar a la humanidad. Tus gatos están en ello. Un shooter idle en pixel art que vive al pie de tu pantalla mientras trabajas: cuatro gatos comando luchan, tú ayudas con clics, cobras las recompensas y reequipas a la tripulación.

desc.en: An AI roleplaying adventure shaped by you. Create a character, explore worlds with an AI game master.
desc.fr: An AI roleplaying adventure shaped by you. Create a character, explore worlds with an AI game master.
desc.zh-CN: 用你的选择塑造 AI 角色扮演冒险。创建角色，与 AI 游戏主持人探索世界。
desc.ja: An AI roleplaying adventure shaped by you. Create a character, explore worlds with an AI game master.
desc.es: An AI roleplaying adventure shaped by you. Create a character, explore worlds with an AI game master.

desc.en: Command your one and only army in a compact turn-based strategy played across a medieval war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, build your realm and storm rival capitals, then watch your tiny soldiers settle the fight in fast automatic battles.
desc.fr: Command your one and only army in a compact turn-based strategy played across a medieval war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, build your realm and storm rival capitals, then watch your tiny soldiers settle the fight in fast automatic battles.
desc.zh-CN: Command your one and only army in a compact turn-based strategy played across a medieval war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, build your realm and storm rival capitals, then watch your tiny soldiers settle the fight in fast automatic battles.
desc.ja: Command your one and only army in a compact turn-based strategy played across a medieval war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, build your realm and storm rival capitals, then watch your tiny soldiers settle the fight in fast automatic battles.
desc.es: Command your one and only army in a compact turn-based strategy played across a medieval war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, build your realm and storm rival capitals, then watch your tiny soldiers settle the fight in fast automatic battles.

name: QUTAS67 - Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067

desc.en: QUTAS 67 is a clicker game set in the year 2067, where players build a criminal empire by clicking and hiring managers to rob increasingly larger buildings with the ultimate goal of finally "releasing" the iconic, endlessly delayed game. 6️⃣7️⃣
desc.fr: QUTAS67 est un jeu de clics situé en 2067. Construisez un empire criminel en cliquant et en recrutant des gérants pour cambrioler des bâtiments toujours plus importants. Votre objectif ultime : enfin « sortir » le jeu culte dont la sortie est repoussée sans cesse. 6️⃣7️⃣
desc.zh-CN: QUTAS67是一款以2067年为背景的点击游戏。通过不断点击和雇用经理，抢劫规模越来越大的建筑，建立犯罪帝国。最终目标？亲手让那款无数次延期的传奇游戏终于“发售”！6️⃣7️⃣
desc.ja: QUTAS67は2067年を舞台にしたクリッカーゲーム。クリックとマネージャーの雇用で犯罪帝国を築き、次々と大きな建物を襲おう。最終目標は、延期され続けた伝説のゲームをついに「発売」すること！ 6️⃣7️⃣
desc.es: QUTAS67 es un juego de clics ambientado en 2067 en el que construyes un imperio criminal haciendo clic y contratando gestores para atracar edificios cada vez más grandes. ¿Tu objetivo final? Conseguir que por fin «salga» el legendario juego que lleva una eternidad retrasándose. 6️⃣7️⃣

desc.en: "The Crowley blood stains the mansion's hallways, where voices whisper horrors that time tried to bury."
desc.fr: "Le sang des Crowley tache les couloirs du manoir, où des voix chuchotent des horreurs que le temps a tenté d'enterrer."
desc.zh-CN: "克劳利的血染红了大宅的走廊，声音低语着被时间试图埋葬的恐怖。"
desc.ja: "クロウリーの血が屋敷の廊下を染め、時が葬ろうとした恐怖の声が囁く。"
desc.es: "La sangre de los Crowley mancha los pasillos de la mansión, donde voces susurran horrores que el tiempo intentó enterrar."

desc.en: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.
desc.fr: Un roguelike de défense autobattler où la chance rencontre la stratégie. Faites tourner une machine à sous 3×3 pour invoquer des unités et renforcez votre armée en absorbant les autres. Utilisez Objets et Noyaux pour influencer les probabilités et survivre aux vagues de jugement et aux boss.
desc.zh-CN: 这是一款让运气与策略交织的 Roguelike 自动战斗防守游戏。转动 3x3老虎机来召唤单位，通过吸收其他单位来壮大你的军队。利用道具与核心改变概率、扭转局势，并在危险的审判波次与 Boss 战中生存下来。每一次转动，每一个选择，都至关重要。
desc.ja: 運と戦略が交差する、ローグライト・オートバトラー防衛ゲーム。3x3 スロットマシンを回してユニットを召喚し、仲間を吸収して軍勢を強化しましょう。アイテムとコアを駆使して確率を操り、手強い審判ウェーブやボスウェーブを生き残れ。すべてのスピンと、すべての選択が勝敗を分けます。
desc.es: Un roguelike de defensa autobattler donde la suerte se une a la estrategia. Gira una tragaperras 3×3 para invocar unidades y fortalece tu ejército absorbiendo otras. Usa Objetos y Núcleos para manipular las probabilidades y supera oleadas de juicio y jefes. Cada giro y decisión cuentan.

desc.en: Sudoku, beautifully set. 200 puzzles across four difficulty levels - Easy, Medium, Hard and Supreme. Every puzzle has one unique solution, with difficulty shaped by the logic it takes to solve it.
desc.fr: Le sudoku, avec élégance. 200 grilles réparties en quatre niveaux de difficulté : Facile, Moyen, Difficile et Suprême. Chaque grille a une solution unique, et sa difficulté dépend de la logique nécessaire pour la résoudre.
desc.zh-CN: 精致优雅的数独。200 道谜题，分为简单、中等、困难和至尊四个难度。每道谜题都有唯一解，难度取决于解题所需的逻辑技巧。
desc.ja: 美しく仕上げた数独。かんたん・ふつう・むずかしい・スプリームの4つの難易度に200問を収録。どのパズルも答えはひとつで、難易度は解くために必要な論理によって決まります。
desc.es: Sudoku con una presentación exquisita. 200 rompecabezas en cuatro niveles de dificultad: Fácil, Medio, Difícil y Supremo. Cada rompecabezas tiene una única solución y su dificultad depende de la lógica necesaria para resolverlo.

name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

desc.en: Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition brings the epic fantasy to life in stunning detail. The Special Edition includes the critically acclaimed game and add-ons with all-new features.
desc.fr: Lauréat de plus de 200 récompenses du Jeu de l'année, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition donne vie jusque dans ses moindres détails à un univers de fantasy épique. La Special Edition contient le jeu et ses extensions acclamés par la critique ainsi que de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
desc.zh-CN: 荣获超过200项年度游戏大奖的《The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim》推出特别版，以令人惊叹的细致画面带来史诗奇幻巨作。特别版内含大获好评的主游戏、附加内容，还有全新功能。
desc.ja: 200以上のGame of the Yearアワードを獲得した『The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition』は、詳細にわたる描写で無限のファンタジーに命を吹き込みます。Special Editionには高い評価を受けた基本ゲームやアドオンに加え、新しい機能が含まれます。
desc.es: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition, ganador de más de 200 premios al “Juego del año”, da vida a la fantasía épica con un nivel de detalle asombroso. La Special Edition incluye el juego aclamado por la crítica y complementos con nuevas funcionalidades.

desc.en: A 2D puzzle game inspired by the erratic behaviours of Portuguese drivers... especially in roundabouts... because as we all know it, as soon as you enter a roundabout the common sense goes out the window.
desc.fr: A 2D puzzle game inspired by the erratic behaviours of Portuguese drivers... especially in roundabouts... because as we all know it, as soon as you enter a roundabout the common sense goes out the window.
desc.zh-CN: A 2D puzzle game inspired by the erratic behaviours of Portuguese drivers... especially in roundabouts... because as we all know it, as soon as you enter a roundabout the common sense goes out the window.

desc.es: A 2D puzzle game inspired by the erratic behaviours of Portuguese drivers... especially in roundabouts... because as we all know it, as soon as you enter a roundabout the common sense goes out the window.

desc.en: We are the world’s premier motorsports racing game. An iRacing membership provides entry into the newest form of motorsport: internet racing. Internet racing is a fun, easy, and inexpensive way for race fan and gamers alike to enjoy the thrill of the racetrack from the comfort of their home.
